name: @epoch/experience-compiler
description: Epoch Experience Compiler v1 (Work Order W012, experience layer): the pure projection stage between the W011 Experience Protocol and the W013 renderer surfaces. It VALIDATES Experience Graph envelopes with the W011 admission discipline and COMPILES them into deterministic, renderer-ready, content-addressed Render Plans (staged, sorted, device-shaped, tenant-scoped). It is never semantic authority, never mutates kernel state, and never becomes a second semantic store (architecture lock rules 8/16).
